app_summary: Tenzy is a personal-assistant toolbox: ready-made tools (templates) and user-built tools that turn photos, videos, PDFs, sound and text into useful results on the phone, then save or share them.

features.name: Privacy share shield
features.purpose: Hides sensitive details, strips the photo's location and shrinks it to 2 MB before sharing
features.expected_result: Hides sensitive details, strips the photo's location and shrinks it to 2 MB before sharing

features.name: ID copy with a safety watermark
features.purpose: Stamps 'For verification only' on an ID photo and removes its location
features.expected_result: Stamps 'For verification only' on an ID photo and removes its location

features.name: Photo to PDF
features.purpose: Turns a photo into a PDF document
features.expected_result: Turns a photo into a PDF document

features.name: Text or link to QR code
features.purpose: Makes a QR code image from text or a link
features.expected_result: Makes a QR code image from text or a link

features.name: Pull links, emails and phones
features.purpose: Finds the links, email addresses and phone numbers in a block of text
features.expected_result: Finds the links, email addresses and phone numbers in a block of text

features.name: Link without the tracking
features.purpose: Removes tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid) from a link
features.expected_result: Removes tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid) from a link

features.name: Video without its sound
features.purpose: Removes the audio track from a video
features.expected_result: Removes the audio track from a video

features.name: Grab a still from a video
features.purpose: Saves one frame of a video as a photo
features.expected_result: Saves one frame of a video as a photo

features.name: Video under 25 MB for email
features.purpose: Shrinks a video under 25 MB and opens email
features.expected_result: Shrinks a video under 25 MB and opens email

features.name: Video to a GIF
features.purpose: Turns a video into an animated GIF
features.expected_result: Turns a video into an animated GIF

features.name: Just the first page of a PDF
features.purpose: Keeps only page 1 of a PDF
features.expected_result: Keeps only page 1 of a PDF

features.name: PDF under 5 MB for email
features.purpose: Shrinks a PDF under 5 MB and opens email
features.expected_result: Shrinks a PDF under 5 MB and opens email

features.name: Chipmunk voice
features.purpose: Changes a voice recording to a chipmunk voice
features.expected_result: Changes a voice recording to a chipmunk voice

features.name: Text to an audio file
features.purpose: Reads text aloud into an audio file
features.expected_result: Reads text aloud into an audio file

features.name: Photo to a pencil sketch
features.purpose: Turns a photo into a pencil sketch
features.expected_result: Turns a photo into a pencil sketch

features.name: Long text to 3 sentences
features.purpose: Summarises long text into three sentences
features.expected_result: Summarises long text into three sentences

features.name: Photo under 2 MB
features.purpose: Shrink a photo to under 2 MB

features.name: Video small enough for chat (16 MB)
features.purpose: Shrink a video for chat apps
